claim: When you use a One Zone file system with Amazon ECS, Amazon EKS or AWS Lambda, you need to configure the service to use the same Availability Zone as the file system: with Amazon ECS you should choose only subnets in that Availability Zone when launching your task, and with Lambda you configure your function to only launch invocations into subnets in that Availability Zone.

evidence.quote: To use EFS One Zone file systems with Amazon ECS you should choose only subnets that are in the same Availability Zone as your file system when launching your task.
When you use Lambda with One Zone file systems, configure your function to only launch invocations into subnets that are in the same Availability Zone as your file system.

When you use a One Zone file system with Amazon Elastic Container Service, Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service, or AWS Lambda, you need to configure the service to use the same Availability Zone that the EFS file system is located in, illustrated as follows, and described in the following sections.
